##### Project general facts

Floarea Breeze by Mashriq Elite Developments brings a refined vision of island-inspired living to the heart of Dubai Islands. Designed to merge serenity with connectivity, the project captures the essence of coastal life through thoughtful architecture and natural surroundings. Its tranquil environment, enhanced by landscaped greenery and open waterfront views, creates a haven where modern comfort meets the rhythm of the sea. With easy access to major landmarks and Dubai’s key hubs, the community offers both retreat and convenience in perfect balance.

Every aspect of Floarea Breeze reflects Mashriq Elite’s signature approach to quality and livability. Elegant façades, a grand designer lobby, and floor-to-ceiling glass windows define the building’s contemporary aesthetic. The residences are crafted for comfort, featuring generous layouts that maximize light and space. Families and professionals alike will find a setting that promotes both privacy and connection — where refined design complements the calm energy of the waterfront lifestyle.

Residents enjoy a full range of resort-style amenities that elevate every moment. The development includes a lavish swimming pool, a dedicated kids’ pool, an indoor gym, an outdoor fitness zone, a meditation deck, rooftop BBQ areas, a sky lounge, and recreational spaces such as outdoor table tennis, carrom, and foosball. Smart features like Alexa-integrated home automation and ANPR parking systems further enhance daily convenience, making Floarea Breeze a perfect embodiment of relaxed sophistication on the Dubai coastline.

Floarea Breeze features premium European finishes and fittings. Living areas include decorative walls with wood-textured accents, while bedrooms come with built-in MDF wardrobes and dresser consoles. Kitchens are fully fitted with Bosch appliances and quartz countertops, complemented by porcelain backsplashes and high-quality European hardware. Bathrooms are equipped with sanitary ware from GESSI, LAUFEN, and IWW. Each home includes a Smart Home System powered by Alexa, with glass touch panels and digital climate control for effortless comfort.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters.

The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities.

Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.
